title: The Golem
start: Talk to the clay golem in the ruins of Uzer.

items.t: A phoenix feather from the Desert Phoenix (obtained during quest)

recommended.t: Multiple waterskins (or an enchanted water tiara to save backpack space)
Desert robes to reduce the usage of waterskins
A charged amulet of glory or an enchanted broomstick for quick teleportation to Shantay Pass
Dominion medallion for quick trips to Uzer and the Desert Phoenix
A Dig Site pendant or Archaeology journal for faster access to the Varrock Dig Site
Traveller's necklace for teleport to just south of eagles' eyrie, which is just north west of Uzer

rewards.t: As an extra reward, you may search Thammaron's throne to get six gems – 2 rubies, 2 emeralds, and 2 sapphires – if you did not do so during the quest
A new magic carpet route to the ruins of Uzer
Ability to collect multiple phoenix feathers without using the drop trick

steps.t: Head east of the Shantay Pass to Uzer (north-east of the fairy ring DLQ).

sub.t: If running from the Shantay Pass, pick up the phoenix feather on the way.

p: The black mushrooms and the stairs in the ruins.

steps.t: Talk to the broken clay golem. [Chat: Accept]
With four soft clay in your backpack, use one on the golem. All four will be used to repair the golem.
Talk to the golem. [Chat: 1 How do I open the portal?]
Pick up and read the letter west of the clay golem.
Pick a black mushroom, found on the south-east corner of the stairs leading into the ruins.
Climb down the stairs in the ruins east of the golem.
Head to the north-western room and pick up the strange implement.
Teleport to the Varrock Dig Site using the Archaeology journal, or teleport to Varrock and run east, or teleport to Fort Forinthry and run south.

Use the letter on Elissa and talk to Elissa who is east of the winch in the north-east corner of the digsite (just north of The Stormbreaker ship). [Chat: 3 I found a letter in the desert with your name on.]
Head to the Exam Centre just south of the Dig Site.
Search the bookshelf on the southern wall and read Varmen's notes.

Talk to Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum about the statuette. [Chat: 3 I'm looking for a statuette recovered from the city of Uzer. › 1 I want to open a portal to the lair of an elder-demon.] (If The chat options are not coming up make sure you repaired the golem and have read Varmen's notes)
Pickpocket him for the display cabinet key.
Head upstairs and use the display cabinet key on the northwestern most case to get the statuette.
Return to Shantay Pass and cross into the desert.
p: The golem informs you of its task.

steps.t: Go east to the Desert Phoenix, and grab a phoenix feather.

sub.t: Make sure you un-equip any item porters, as wearing an activated Porter or grace of the elves will teleport the feather to your bank.
Make sure you un-equip the Thieving Cape or Thieving master cape, as they will cause the feather to be noted.

steps.t: Go to the ruins of Uzer where you started the quest and go back down the stairs.
In the centre of the room will be four alcoves. Place the statuette in the empty one.
Turn the statuettes so they all point north towards the double doors. You may have to click "turn" more than once.
Go north, through the double doors.

sub.t: Optional: Take the gems from the throne at the north side of the room to unlock the achievement Looting the Demon Throne and obtain two cut rubies, two cut emeralds, and two cut sapphires.

steps.t: Go back through the south portal.
Go back upstairs and talk to the golem.
With an empty vial in your backpack, right click Grind the black mushroom (Don't left click "Eat" it).
p: The display case that the statuette resides in.

steps.t: Use the phoenix feather on the black mushroom ink.
Use the phoenix quill pen on a piece of papyrus to get the golem program.
Use the Strange implement on the golem then quickly use the newly acquired golem program on the golem.
Quest complete!

p: The four statuettes, facing the door.

get_inside.text: Entrance to the underground remains of Uzer
pic: Entrance to the underground remains of Uzer

get_inside.text: Walk east of the Dominion Tower
Uzer can be reached easily after Eagles' Peak is completed by flying a Desert eagle in the Eagle transport system.
Ali Morrisane's magic carpet will only be available after The Golem quest.
Fairy ring - DLQ, then walk north-east
Traveller's necklace to south of the Desert Eagle's Eyrie and then walk south-east
Desert amulet 4 to teleport directly there.

The ruins of various buildings and large kilns are in the vicinity of the temple (the large kilns were used to manufacture golems). Several buildings contain crates. Many are extremely small. The city itself does not seem to have been extremely large–perhaps the size of Lumbridge or Draynor, though it may be that Uzer was once much larger but very little remains to be seen . The ruins and the golem are all that remain above the desert sands. Talking to the latter is the way to start The Golem quest. Though there are a number of golem parts strewn around the area, there are no human remains with the exception of ghosts in the temple basement. Very prominent in the area is a large, ornate building that forms the upper part of the temple complex. It is inscribed with the symbols of many gods and has stairs in the centre leading down to the temple basement.

Underneath the city lies the temple basement. To the north-east of the entrance black mushrooms spawn, while in the north-west, one can find a strange implement. Statues of craftsmen adorn the halls while golem pieces litter the ground. A few ghosts lurk in the hallways. At the far end lies a portal to Thammaron's realm. This basement, being underground, is safe from the desert heat effect.

Thammaron's Throne Room is red and grey, while a causeway of horns breaking the ground leads to his throne. To the right of the entrance lies the remains of Thammaron. Members can use a chisel on the throne to receive two cut sapphires, two cut emeralds, and two cut rubies. This room is also a focal part of the Shadow of the Storm quest.
The Uzer mine is found northwest of of the ruins, containing 3 necrite rocks. Between the mine and the ruins are also two acadia trees.
